method: Direct viewing of all nine original exported figures and both layout-only replacements
skill: reconstruction-result-visualizer; explicit user 3D truth/crop0/no smoothing/no fitted-gain contract overrides generic 2D catalog defaults

transport_axial.png.observation: All three routes, truth and 0/10/20/50/100/150/200 columns inspected. Fixed gray_r scale and complete extent. Larger hot spheres resolve; background spots grow with iterations; small spheres remain limited.

transport_coronal.png.observation: Original row labels clipped. Replacement directly inspected: all three horizontal labels, title, 8 columns and fixed colorbar visible; original scientific planes and extent retained.

transport_sagittal.png.observation: Original row labels clipped. Replacement directly inspected: labels, title, all 8 columns and colorbar visible. Authoritative x=-1.5 plane intersects no hot sphere; absence of hot spheres in its truth is consistent.

transport_mip72.png.observation: Complete three-route 72mm MIP inspected. No filtering or gain fitting. Background peaks rise at late iterations; fixed display ceiling is explicit.

overall_mip72_15_routes.png.observation: All 15 routes inspected with each row actual iteration labels. EHE0-200 and JSCC0-10000 remain distinct. Model-Poisson acquisition is separately labelled, all truth columns retained; no equal-convergence claim.

cnr_full_trajectories.png.observation: All 15 panels inspected, full saved iterations and sphere legends visible. Single-energy 5e10 CNR maxima occur at50-60; later noise penalizes CNR. Init undefined; no stopping policy fitted.

crc_full_trajectories.png.observation: All15 panels inspected; common vertical scale includes negative and >1 values; no clipping or selective omission of unfavorable results.

density_noise_curves.png.observation: All7 metrics and4 systems inspected. Physical gamma density units and separate x ranges; full120mm/native metrics retained. Tenfold dose difference is explicit.

integral_position_curves.png.observation: All6 metrics and4 systems inspected. Integral/recovery, |z|>30 leakage and peak positions visible. Uniform-init peak omitted; late peak movement retained.

limits: Existing response discrepancy is preserved; user continued original method; no new physical calibration claimed
5e10 versus 5e9 includes a tenfold dose difference; not an isolated algorithm comparison
Model-Poisson data are a distinct generated realization and not Geant4 observations
EHE218 background budget is own440200; JSCC218 background budget is prior44010000
Materials, detector coverage, truncation and response approximations differ
Each system retains its full iteration range; same iteration or column is not equal convergence
CNR peaks are descriptive for one acquisition; not a fitted stopping policy or device-performance estimate
